scientific_integrity: Analytical proof checked against executable symbolic/finite-dimensional tests; arithmetic experiments are not the infinite-dimensional proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact bilinear square invertible games, equal damping gains, synchronous explicit update, fixed controller parameters, real exact arithmetic. Aligned coupling is consensus-type and not new. Continuous-time stability and other nonlinear/unequal-gain cases not addressed. Residual implicit coverage by spectral-shape theory is a bibliographic risk.
title: Coordinate-dependent stability obstruction and an exact aligned-gain phase transition in a discrete minimax controller
